name: jev-workflows
description: Jev classification for tools, models, tasks and arbitrary decisions, with evidence review and automatic Codex lifecycle consultation.

interface.shortDescription: Consult Jev for tools, models, tasks, and evidence-based decisions.
interface.longDescription: Jev Workflows supplies a general closed-choice classifier, failure diagnosis, completion review, and scoped automatic lifecycle consultation. Decisions remain advisory, preserve evidence references, and never grant permissions or invent tool or model availability.
defaultPrompt: Use Jev to choose the next tool, model, or task from the available options.
Classify this using my categories and evidence.
Enable automatic Jev consultation for my Codex work.
